newsitem.title: USA: PMT to buy co with 6,000 merchant accounts.
newsitem.headline: PMT to buy co with 6,000 merchant accounts.

text.p: PMT Services Inc Monday said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire a company with a merchant portfolio of approximately 6,000 accounts.
The firm did not furnish details on the targeted company.

The letter of intent relates to the acquisition of a company with approximately 6,000 merchant accounts, which produce annual charge volume of approximately $700 million. PMT said it expects the deal to close before the end of calendar year 1996.
PMT Services is an independent service organization which markets and services electronic credit card authorization and payment systems to small retail and professional businesses.
